testCases.title: Verify pagination controls are displayed for multiple products
steps: Observe the presence of pagination controls.
expectedResults: Pagination controls are displayed on the page.

testCases.title: Verify that clicking a page number updates the product grid
steps: Click on a page number in the pagination controls.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to display products for the selected page.

testCases.title: Verify that current page number is highlighted after navigation
steps: Click on a page number in the pagination controls.
expectedResults: The selected page number is visually highlighted.
